notes: Air facilities that are never built, moved or removed: the Maltese bases printed on the Malta inset (44.12) and the Axis's off-map and Mediterranean boxes. Bombing can bring their capacity to zero but never destroys them (36.5, 44.12); the Axis bases in Italy, Sicily and Crete cannot be bombed at all (36.5, 43.2). The Commonwealth's off-map bases (36.53) are commonwealth_bases in air-off-map-distances.json, with the same kind of id; a scenario's fixed facility names a row of either.
max_capacity counts levels for Malta, where a level serves up to 18 aircraft of any type and no SGSUs are used (44.14, R-165). null: no limit is printed.

The Malta rows are read from the printed Map A inset (jp2 187), whose terrain key tells the symbols apart: four airfields, Kalafrana's flying-boat basin and Valletta's alighting area, each with its standard level; the VASSAL redraw agrees. Hal Far's symbol sits in M0505; data/map/places.json puts the Hal Far label at M0504.
